title: multi-lead-tactical-rounds-2027-09-28
content:
Date: 2027-09-28
Time: 09:30-10:30 PT
Location: Zoom / Platform huddle room
Facilitator: Priya Raman
Attendees: Priya, Marcus, Ava, Diego, Linus, Sarah (SRE), Colin (Serving Runtime), Maya (Observability lead, joined for first 20m)

Purpose: quick cross-team operational check, unblock priority rollouts, highlight staffing/coverage risks ahead of next month, and surface any emergent infra or customer-impacting issues. Keep to tactical decisions and clear owners.

Agenda + Notes:
1) Quick metrics snapshot (5m)
- P50 latency (hosted API) this week: 78ms (up 6ms week-over-week). Notable spike on Wed 11:30-12:15 PT tied to model cache misses.
- Error rate: 0.28% 5xx (steady). Serving-runtime backlog increased 12% during peak.
- Dedicated: two capacity customers reported jitter during multi-tenant burst.
- Action: Marcus to validate cache warming heuristics and push a short-term tweak by 09/30. (Owner: Marcus, due 2027-09-30)

2) Rollout calendar & canary health (10m)
- Rolling out runtime v2.11 to hosted nodes this week (canary pool: 50 nodes). Canary passed CPU/latency gates but saw higher memory churn on long-context tests.
- Decision: pause broad rollout until next canary batch after memory churn analysis. (Decider: Priya with runtime and infra leads)
- Action: Colin to instrument per-request peak RSS and KV-cache retention metrics; deliver initial findings by 2027-09-29.

3) Private deployment (customer A) onboarding blockers (10m)
- Customer A hit a networking policy mismatch when deploying during their air-gapped validation. Root cause: missing DNS override in installer template.
- Short-term: provide patched installer and run validation run with the customer. Ava will join the call with customer engineering tomorrow. (Owner: Ava, due 2027-09-29)
- Longer-term: add a preflight check for DNS entries to the private-deploy pipeline. (Owner: Diego, due 2027-10-12)

4) On-call & incident preparedness (10m)
- Recent incident (09/22) postmortem draft is in progress; first pass shows an operator error in fallback routing plus insufficient observability on cache eviction.
- Action: SRE to add alert for abnormal eviction rates (threshold TBD) and create runbook step for safe rollback to model-variant fallback. (Owner: Sarah, due 2027-10-05)
- Staffing note: two primary on-call engineers will be unavailable 10/4-10/10 (vacation overlap). Need additional rotation coverage. Linus to propose backfill plan. (Owner: Linus, due 2027-09-30)

5) Cost optimization experiments (10m)
- Redwood Optimize suggestion: test mixed-quantization variant for 3 midweight models. Expected 18-25% token cost reduction on long prompts.
- Decision: run A/B test against 10% of traffic for 2 weeks. Emphasize quality monitoring via eval set. (Owner: Diego + Applied ML, start 2027-10-04)
- Linked artifact: JIRA-PLAT-2910 for experiment tracking.

6) Observability gaps and tracing rollout (8m)
- Maya called out traces missing for cross-region fallbacks; root cause is the sampling policy defaulting to local-only for the fallback path.
- Action: change sampling config to include 1% of fallback requests for full traces and add dashboard tile. (Owner: Maya, due 2027-10-03)

7) Cross-team people/ops and hiring note (5m)
- Platform eng headcount: two new ICs start mid-Oct; need mentoring plan and rotation slots. Marcus to draft an onboarding 30/60/90 for infra vs runtime rotations by 2027-10-01.
- Reminder: apply for conference travel budget by 10/07.

8) Parking lot / Raised items (last 10m)
- Colin: request to fast-track the kernel selection telemetry patch — PR ready but needs QA cycles. Priya: prioritize to next sprint if SLO tests pass. (Owner: Colin, PR link in artifacts)
- Ava: propose an internal dry-run for private deployment installer next week to surface other idempotency issues. Tentative slot: 10/05.

Decisions made:
- Hold broad runtime v2.11 rollout until memory churn is resolved and additional canary metrics are collected.
- Proceed with cost A/B test for mixed-quantization on a 10% traffic slice starting 2027-10-04.

Action items (summarized):
- Marcus: validate cache warming heuristics and push short tweak (due 2027-09-30).
- Colin: instrument per-request peak RSS and KV-cache retention metrics (due 2027-09-29).
- Ava: perform patched installer validation with Customer A (due 2027-09-29).
- Diego: add preflight DNS check to private-deploy pipeline (due 2027-10-12); own cost experiment start (2027-10-04).
- Sarah (SRE): add alert for abnormal eviction rates + runbook step (due 2027-10-05).
- Linus: propose on-call backfill plan (due 2027-09-30).
- Maya: enable 1% tracing for fallback path + dashboard tile (due 2027-10-03).
- Marcus: onboarding plan for new hires (due 2027-10-01).

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: memory churn in runtime could increase latency regressions during high-concurrency long-context workloads. Mitigation: pause rollout, collect per-request memory metrics, and run stress job on staging cluster replicating 90th percentile context lengths.
- Risk: on-call coverage gaps during early Oct vacations. Mitigation: Linus to secure backfill and SRE to shift some alerts to follow-the-sun temporary policy.

Next meeting: 2027-10-05 09:30 PT
Optional pre-read: runtime canary telemetry snapshot (linked in artifacts)
Notes taken by: Priya Raman
Document status: draft — will be updated with postmortem link and PR numbers after follow-ups

Informal notes / items to capture for playbook:
- Consider automated cache-warm triggers based on model-hotset observed in the last 24h to avoid manual heuristics.
- Suggest lightweight preflight for customer private deployments (DNS, proxy, certs, KMS handshake) — create small checklist card in Confluence.
- Experimentation note: ensure human-in-the-loop quality gates for quantized A/B tests (eval set + production-sampled prompts).
